_meta.status: DEMONSTRATIVE / SIMULATED. Not a PPC / Transelectrica asset. No real grid measurements.
_meta.conductor_source: Conductor, span and weather parameters of CIGRE TB 601 'Example B' exactly as reproduced in the official LineRate example https://statnett.github.io/linerate/auto_examples/plot_cigre.html (the docs describe the example as taken from CIGRE TB 601, Example B). The docs do NOT name the conductor type, so we do not name it either. Roughly a 28.1 mm ACSR-class conductor.
_meta.units_source: Units from https://statnett.github.io/linerate/api/types.html (diameters m, temperatures degC, resistance ohm/m, albedo/emissivity dimensionless).
_meta.not_in_linerate_docs: Everything under 'operating', 'span' and 'static_rating' is OUR simulation assumption (not from LineRate/CIGRE). Team must confirm. Each value is annotated below.

conductor._notes: aluminium_cross_section_area=null is converted to NaN in code, exactly as float('nan') in the official example ('No core magnetisation loss'). Units: m, m, m, -, -, degC, degC, ohm/m, ohm/m, m^2, -, m^2/A, -.

span._notes: SIMULATED. LineRate derives the conductor azimuth from tower coordinates, so each segment is represented by two towers placed +-length_m/2 along its azimuth around the segment midpoint (flat-earth offset, zero inclination). length_m does not affect the CIGRE ampacity except through azimuth/inclination. default_altitude_m is used only if the segment config has no altitude_m. num_conductors=1 (simplex) as in the official example.

operating._notes: max_conductor_temperature_c=75 is our ASSUMPTION; chosen equal to the upper resistance reference temperature (temperature2) so that no resistance extrapolation beyond the datasheet-style points is needed. ground_albedo=0.2 is the 'soil, grass and crops' value from the LineRate solar_heating docstring (Dobrogea is mostly farmland) - the official example uses 0.15. clearness_ratio_max=1.0 caps the GHI-derived clearness ratio (our assumption, see physics_engine.estimate_clearness_ratio). search bounds/tolerance are LineRate defaults except tolerance (default 1.0 A).

static_rating._notes: PROPOSED by Participant 2, NOT an official or PPC/Transelectrica static-rating convention - the team must confirm or replace. 0.61 m/s (~2 ft/s) is a commonly used conservative static-rating wind speed convention; 35 degC and solstice-noon full-clearness are conservative-summer placeholders. Computed with the same CIGRE601 physics as the dynamic labels, per segment, so static vs dynamic differ only by weather.
